Hi Sarah — great to hear! We'd love to host. Answers below and a next step action list.

1) Visitor NDA: attached (PDF) — we can accept DocuSign. Please sign the ClariTech counterpart before arrival.
-- attachment: Visitor_NDA_ClariTech.pdf (application/pdf, 178KB)

2) Gate pass / preregistration: yes, please send the full names and emails for all 7 attendees and we'll generate day passes. If anyone needs a badge beyond 3 hours, note it in the attendee list.

3) Preferred arrival windows on Apr 18: we have demos scheduled 10:00–12:30 and 14:00–16:00. If you want a full‑day run through (including lunch), arrive by 09:30. Otherwise a 13:30 arrival works for afternoon only. Which do you prefer?

4) Wi‑Fi/AV: guests get a dedicated visitor SSID with internet and whitelisted conference resources. No laptop pre‑install required; network access is isolated. If you want a shared test dataset or an air‑gapped demo VM, Marissa can provision.

Next steps (action items):
- Sarah: confirm attendee list + preferred arrival window and sign NDA (DocuSign link below).
- Kimberly: will issue gate passes and confirm room reservation when attendee list arrives.
- Priyom & Marissa (cc): please hold Conference Room B (2nd floor) 09:30–17:00 and provision a demo VM if Sarah requests it.
